title: AI Software Engineer
summary: AI Software Engineer and Tech Lead with **9+ years** of experience. Specialized in developing **multi-agent systems**, building scalable web architectures, and configuring **cloud infrastructure** and CI/CD integrations.

bullets: Developed **multi-agent systems** connecting foundation models (Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude) through the **AWS Bedrock and Vertex AI** platforms.
Built **MCP servers** (Model Context Protocol) from scratch to securely connect AI agents to databases and external APIs, giving them **real-time context**.
**Optimized API consumption** and reduced latency by tuning context windows, selecting the ideal model for each process, and applying **prompt engineering** techniques.
**Scaled the backend architecture** (PHP, Python) and the Moodle environment to handle the load of new AI tools in production without affecting performance.
Integrated **AI assistants** (Claude Code CLI, Google Antigravity) into the team's workflow to **accelerate development** and technical incident resolution.
Configured **CI/CD pipelines** to automate production releases and managed servers on AWS and Linux, ensuring **system stability**.
Defined the **technical architecture** and technology strategy, evaluating third-party APIs and guiding the team in adopting new tools across several parallel projects.
Improved code quality and eased onboarding of new developers by implementing **code reviews**, static analysis (ESLint), and agile workflows.
Managed **production infrastructure** on Linux servers (firewalls, Datadog) and automated deployments with **GitHub Actions**, eliminating manual work and reducing release errors.
Built **full web applications** using Laravel and relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) on the backend, along with dynamic JavaScript and Vue.js interfaces.
**Improved application speed** by refactoring database queries and redesigning the interface for a better user experience.
Translated business requirements into technical specifications, following each project from kickoff to **deployment** to ensure on-time delivery.
Created and maintain an **ecosystem of open-source tools** (including TaskFlow and Vue/Laravel utilities) focused on streamlining the development cycle.
Lead **end-to-end management on GitHub**: defining next technical steps, reviewing pull requests, and resolving issues reported by the community.
Improved the **developer experience (DX)** by building ready-to-use modules and test environments that eliminate hours of manual work for other developers.
